project_title: GiftsDates - International Dating, Gifts & Escrow Date Booking Platform
theme: Dark Luxury & Romantic Velvet (Deep Obsidian #0D0B12, Rose Velvet #E11D48, Warm Gold #F59E0B, Crimson Amethyst #8B5CF6)
emotional_archetype: LUXURY & ROMANTIC DEPTH (Archetype 5) - Expensive, cinematic, warm, tactile with soft glass accents and gold coin highlights

typography.heading_font: Playfair Display / Cormorant Garamond / Cabinet Grotesk (Serif & High-End Display for titles & badges)
typography.body_font: Plus Jakarta Sans / Inter / Figtree (Clean Sans for crisp readability across 8 languages)
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono (For coin balances, transaction IDs, escrow countdown timers, withdrawal calculations)

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-tight

location_search_and_profiles.grid_mode: Tetris / Bento Grid (Asymmetric profile cards with distance badges, city tags, online indicators)
location_search_and_profiles.filter_bar: Sticky top bar with city/country selector, age range slider, verified photo toggle, premium-only filter
location_search_and_profiles.like_match_action: Floating glass action dock with Heart (Like), Gift (Send Virtual Item), Video Call, Book Date buttons

virtual_gifts_and_commission.commission_rate: 30% platform commission auto-deducted on gifts (Receiver gets 70% in withdrawable balance)
virtual_gifts_and_commission.gift_catalog: Tiered visual catalog (Roses 50 coins, Champagne 250 coins, Luxury Watch 1000 coins, Diamond Ring 5000 coins)
virtual_gifts_and_commission.gift_modal: Includes custom message box, coin balance check, instant Stripe coin top-up shortcut if low balance

date_booking_and_escrow.escrow_rules: Funds held in 24-hour escrow after scheduled date. Requires photo proof upload from date venue to release payment.
date_booking_and_escrow.withdrawal_eligibility: Withdrawable funds come from received gifts (70% net) and completed photo-confirmed dates.
date_booking_and_escrow.ui_step_flow: 1. Select Venue/City -> 2. Propose Date & Time -> 3. Lock Coins in Escrow -> 4. Attend Date & Upload Verification Photo -> 5. 24h Countdown Timer -> 6. Payout Available for Withdrawal

coin_wallet_and_stripe.topup_packages: 100 coins ($9.99), 500 coins ($44.99 + 50 bonus), 2000 coins ($149.99 + 300 bonus), Monthly VIP Pass ($29.99/mo)
coin_wallet_and_stripe.stripe_integration: Modal payment form with simulated or live Stripe elements, transaction history table with status badges (Held, Released, Withdrawn)
coin_wallet_and_stripe.payout_withdrawal: Withdrawal request form (Bank / Crypto / Card) with minimum threshold check and fee breakdown

video_calls.call_interface: Full-screen luxury dark glass video frame with camera toggle, mic mute, animated coin drop meter per minute, gift drop overlay

component_architecture.header_nav: Fixed crystal glass banner (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0D0B12]/80 border-b border-white/10 z-50`). Contains Logo, Language Switcher Dropdown (8 flags), Wallet Coin Chip, Notification Bell, Profile Avatar, and CTA
component_architecture.profile_card: Vertical visual hero card with gradient dark scrim overlay, subtle hover lift (`hover:-translate-y-1.5 transition-all duration-300`), age & location badge, verification mark, online pulsing dot
component_architecture.language_switcher: Dropdown menu with 8 language flags, label, LTR/RTL dynamic layout support (Arabic handles `dir='rtl'` seamlessly)
component_architecture.wallet_dashboard: Grid of 3 summary cards (Coin Balance, Escrow Pending, Withdrawable Balance) + Transaction Table + Withdrawal Request Drawer + Coin Top-Up Modal
component_architecture.chat_messaging: Split view with active conversation list, message bubbles, inline gift attachment preview, 'Book Date' shortcut button
component_architecture.toast_notifications: Sonner toast with customized dark rose styling (`bg-[#161320] border border-rose-500/30 text-white`)

luxury_gifts.description: Luxury Black Box with Red Roses
Premium Velvet Gift Box with Champagne

testing_and_attributes.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements MUST have explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow dark luxury dating & escrow theme with deep obsidian (#0D0B12) background, rose accent (#E11D48) and gold accents (#F59E0B).
Ensure all 8 languages (RU, EN, ES, FR, DE, PT, ZH, AR) are selectable from top nav with instant UI text updates and RTL support for Arabic.
Display wallet balances clearly: Coins, Escrow (1-day hold after date photo confirmation), and Withdrawable Earnings (Gifts after 30% fee + Escrow payouts).
Include demo photo verification step for dates to release escrow funds after 24h.
Include full interactive video call simulation with coin timer and gift sending during calls.
Add complete Stripe coin package purchase modal with instant coin credit.
Apply data-testid to every button, filter, input, modal action, and navigation link.
